body:
1. Food is one way to make a pet happy, like petting and toys. Never needed.
2. 3 food groups, each pet loves one:
🥩 Meat: dog, pug, pomchi, sausage dog, owl, bear, snake.
🐟 Fish: cat, seal.
🥕 Fruit & veggies: bunny, hamster, capybara, duck, monkey.
🍖 Treats: every pet, cheaper, same +30 as other food.
3. Every pet eats every food. Its group's food gives the bigger boost (+40 vs +30, as today) and a happy dance.
4. No new items: today's Pet food becomes Meat, Cat food becomes Fish, Bunny & hamster food becomes Fruit & veggies. Same items, so food already in bags keeps working.
5. No current pet changes favourite.
6. Prices as today: 6 coins, treats 5.
7. The bowl at home takes any food. One food fills it for one game day of play, then it's empty.
8. No food at all in your bag: "Ms. Paws sells meat, fish, fruit & veggies."
9. In the pet shop, each food says who loves it ("Fish: cats and seals love it").
10. Build: each pet type has one food-group word, not its own food list.
